cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

mechanism: A organizes a move and drops measuring to make B choose which incompatible size explanation determines the next practical step.
confusable: Unlike asking for any useful idea, A requires one of two mutually incompatible realities and then follows its consequences.
comparison: A shrinking move with outside help differs from gravity returning to a floating buffet.
seedUse: D154-a room or people scale, sofa, brother and tweezers; S02-a abandons a preliminary demand around B urgency.
